explication: Strapi is a self-hosted headless CMS: developers define content models, creators manage and publish content in the admin, and applications consume generated APIs. The README documents the backend request stages, while the source index exposes selected admin and plugin relationships. The graph also preserves documented capabilities whose implementation was not sampled; those links are grounded in the README rather than assumed source calls.
